name: vue-cursor
title: Vue Cursor
author: Alexey Murz Korepov
description: An oversized Vue 3 cursor with curved motion, follow mode, replaceable SVG shapes, and click animation.

        :fill="fill"

        :stroke-width="strokeWidth"

      />

</template>

<style scoped>
.vue-cursor-shape {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
  transition: transform 80ms ease-out;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    stroke?: string
    fill?: string
    strokeWidth?: number | string
    pressed?: boolean
    button?: 'left' | 'right' | null
  }>(),
  {
    stroke: '#111111',
    fill: '#ffffff',
    strokeWidth: 2,
    pressed: false,
    button: null,
  },
)

const scaledStroke = computed(() => (Number(props.strokeWidth) || 2) * (256 / 24))
</script>

export { default as ArrowCursor } from './ArrowCursor.vue'
export { default as PointerCursor } from './PointerCursor.vue'
export { default as HandCursor } from './HandCursor.vue'

import type { ShapeName } from '../types'
import ArrowCursor from './ArrowCursor.vue'
import PointerCursor from './PointerCursor.vue'
import HandCursor from './HandCursor.vue'
import type { Component } from 'vue'

export const SHAPE_COMPONENTS: Record<ShapeName, Component> = {
  arrow: ArrowCursor,
  pointer: PointerCursor,
  hand: HandCursor,
}

/**
 * Hotspots as fractions of each shape’s viewBox (tip of the cursor).
 * Arrow viewBox: -1 6 13.5 20.5 — tip ≈ (0.9, 8.1), box tight to glyph
 * Pointer viewBox: 0 0 24 24 — tip ≈ (4.5, 3.1) after flip
 * Hand viewBox: 0 0 256 256 — index tip ≈ (107.7, 16) after midline
 */
export const SHAPE_HOTSPOTS: Record<ShapeName, { x: number; y: number }> = {
  arrow: { x: 0.14, y: 0.1 },
  pointer: { x: 0.19, y: 0.13 },
  hand: { x: 0.42, y: 0.06 },
}

/**
 * Tip offset from pointing **up** at CSS rotate(0), in degrees.
 * Hand index points up → 0. Arrow/pointer tips point up-left → -45.
 * Used by dangling motion so the tip aims along travel.
 */
export const SHAPE_DEFAULT_ANGLES: Record<ShapeName, number> = {
  arrow: -45,
  pointer: -45,
  hand: 0,
}
